author: Renata Jones
title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) is Torch Wealth Management LLC’s Largest Position
text:
Posted by Renata Jones on Feb 4th, 2019 // No Comments
Torch Wealth Management LLC trimmed its stake in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 3.0% in the third quarter, according to the company in its most recent disclosure with the Securities & Exchange Commission. The institutional investor owned 45,987 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 1,429 shares during the quarter. Apple makes up about 6.2% of Torch Wealth Management LLC’s portfolio, making the stock its biggest holding. Torch Wealth Management LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $10,381,000 as of its most recent filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission.
A number of other hedge funds also recently bought and sold shares of the business. Wendell David Associates Inc. lifted its position in shares of Apple by 0.6% in the second quarter. Wendell David Associates Inc. now owns 103,039 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $19,074,000 after buying an additional 627 shares during the last quarter. Howard Capital Management Inc. acquired a new stake in shares of Apple in the second quarter valued at approximately $3,457,000. Smithfield Trust Co. lifted its position in shares of Apple by 9.7% in the second quarter. Smithfield Trust Co. now owns 48,450 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $8,968,000 after buying an additional 4,282 shares during the last quarter. Crescent Grove Advisors LLC lifted its position in shares of Apple by 2.3% in the second quarter. Crescent Grove Advisors LLC now owns 20,067 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $3,715,000 after buying an additional 453 shares during the last quarter. Finally, Peavine Capital LLC lifted its position in shares of Apple by 428.7% in the second quarter. Peavine Capital LLC now owns 6,968 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $1,290,000 after buying an additional 5,650 shares during the last quarter. Hedge funds and other institutional investors own 57.00% of the company’s stock. Get Apple alerts:
AAPL has been the subject of a number of recent analyst reports. Citigroup raised their price objective on Apple from $230.00 to $265.00 and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research report on Monday, October 8th. UBS Group set a $250.00 price objective on Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research report on Monday, October 8th. Vertical Group initiated coverage on Apple in a research report on Tuesday, October 9th. They issued a “sell” rating for the company. Bank of America reaffirmed a “buy” rating on shares of Apple in a research report on Tuesday, October 9th. Finally, JPMorgan Chase & Co. reaffirmed a “buy” rating and issued a $272.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, October 10th. Three equities research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-four have assigned a hold rating and twenty-one have issued a buy rating to the stock. Apple currently has an average rating of “Hold” and an average target price of $191.66. Shares of AAPL stock opened at $166.52 on Monday. The firm has a market cap of $818.47 billion, a P/E ratio of 13.98, a PEG ratio of 1.71 and a beta of 1.13. Apple Inc. has a twelve month low of $142.00 and a twelve month high of $233.47. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.79, a quick ratio of 1.25 and a current ratio of 1.30.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its earnings results on Tuesday, January 29th. The iPhone maker reported $4.18 EPS for the quarter, topping the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $4.17 by $0.01. The firm had revenue of $84.31 billion for the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $84.07 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 50.92% and a net margin of 22.72%. Equities research analysts expect that Apple Inc. will post 11.39 EPS for the current fiscal year.
The business also recently announced a quarterly dividend, which will be paid on Thursday, February 14th. Shareholders of record on Monday, February 11th will be issued a dividend of $0.73 per share. This represents a $2.92 annualized dividend and a yield of 1.75%. The ex-dividend date is Friday, February 8th. Apple’s payout ratio is presently 24.52%.
In other Apple news, insider Chris Kondo sold 3,408 shares of Apple stock in a transaction dated Monday, November 19th. The stock was sold at an average price of $190.00, for a total transaction of $647,520.00. Following the transaction, the insider now directly owns 8,940 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $1,698,600. The sale was disclosed in a document filed with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which can be accessed through this link . 0.05% of the stock is currently owned by insiders. Apple Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers. It also sells various related software, services, accessories, and third-party digital content and applications. The company offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers, as well as iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS operating systems.
